title: My Little Cat
story:
I have a cat.
My cat is small.
Its name is Mimi.
Mimi is white.
It has two blue eyes.
Mimi likes milk.
It likes to play.
I love my little cat. ❤️
questions: What is the name of the cat?

title: My Little Dog
story:
I have a dog.
My dog is big.
Its name is Max.
Max is brown.
It has four legs.
It has two big ears.
Max likes to run.
I play with Max every day.
Max is my good friend. 🐶❤️
questions: What is the name of the dog?
How many legs does Max have?
What does Max like to do?
